pages.text: $(bold)Tectonic, Terralith, Biomes O' Plenty$() shape and fill the land. $(bold)Incendium$() is the Nether, $(bold)Nullscape$() the End. $(bold)Serene Seasons$() runs the year, $(bold)Cold Sweat$() the temperature, $(bold)Enhanced Celestials$() the moons.$(br2)$(bold)Geolosys$() places ore in regional deposits. $(bold)Paxi$() loads the pack's own datapack over everything else.

$(bold)Distant Horizons$() draws the far terrain. $(bold)ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village$() builds the villages (every one a ruin now); $(bold)YUNG's$() mineshafts, dungeons and API; $(bold)Structory$() ruins; $(bold)Create Structures$() old workshops.$(br2)$(bold)Village Spawn Point$() puts everyone in the capital.
